question.text: Dividend Discount Model (DDM/Gordon Growth): P = D1 / (r - g). If D1=10, r=12%, g=8%, price is:

explanation.text: The Logic: P = 10 / (0.12 - 0.08) = 10 / 0.04 = Rs. 250. The Trap: 125 uses wrong denominator; 100 uses wrong D. Cross-Exam Context: XV, X-A. Manager's Pro-Tip: DDM works only when g < r; for high-growth firms, use multi-stage DDM or FCFE.
